summary: McCain Foods Holland B.V. is the Dutch operation of the McCain group, whose ultimate parent is McCain Foods Group Inc. in Canada. It makes frozen and chilled potato products for foodservice, mainly fries, using potatoes from contract growers in France, the Netherlands, Belgium and Poland. All Dutch McCain entities together report 1,893 employees.
ownership: Part of McCain Foods Group Inc. (Canada)
products: Crinkle fries (Deep Crinkers, Country Deep Crinkers, Spicy Crinkle Fries)
brands: P!CKERS by McCain Food Service Solutions
markets: Foodservice: restaurants, snack bars, delivery and takeaway
Foodservice sites for about 25 European markets and the MENA region
facts: Dutch entities combined, FY 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2025: revenues CAD 3,172,345,339
Dutch entities combined: profit (loss) before tax CAD -9,659,162
Aims to grow potatoes within a 100 km radius of its processing plants
Each batch of potatoes has a passport for traceability to the field
